topic.description: What the poster is about, named the way a person would describe it.

purpose.description: Why the poster exists and what it has to achieve, written for a human reviewer. Explain the intent fully; there is no length budget, and this text never reaches the image model.

audience.description: Who reads the poster and what they already know. Human-facing context, as detailed as the decision needs.

setting.description: Where, when, and at what distance the poster is seen. Human-facing context, not renderer text.

exact_copy.description: Wording approved to appear in the image, preserved exactly. The only text the image model may render.

constraints.description: Boundaries the design must respect, each stated as a full requirement for a human reviewer.

user_requirements.description: Explicit mandatory requirements confirmed by the user. Copy them exactly; never paraphrase to save space.

execution_route.description: direct when the request already fixes the subject, visual language, exact copy and canvas so no design exploration is needed; staged when a direction or design proposal still has to be developed.

route_reason.description: One sentence explaining the route choice in the task content language.

asset_category.description: Deliverable category chosen by intake; the design stage keeps it.
